# buildnscale.dev

> Free, no-signup productivity tools for developers, plus dated AI model benchmarks and an AI API cost calculator built from first-party list prices.

## AI model cost calculator

- [AI model cost calculator](https://www.buildnscale.dev/ai-costs): Estimates cost per task, per 1,000 tasks, and per month for Claude, GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek. Inputs are tasks, turns, input/output tokens, cache-hit rate, and retry rate. No login and no provider keys; the math runs in the browser.
- Formula: `requests = tasks × turns × (1 + retry rate)` and `monthly = requests × (input tokens × input rate + output tokens × output rate) / 1,000,000`.
- Default example (1,000 tasks, 3 turns, 8,000 input tokens, 700 output tokens, 2% retries): Claude Haiku 5.5 costs $3.52/month and GPT-6 Astra costs $351.90/month.
- Price snapshot: USD list prices per 1M tokens, checked 2026-11-13. Sources are Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and DeepSeek pricing pages, cross-checked against OpenRouter. Anthropic and OpenAI win when sources disagree.
- Modelling notes: cache hits use the cache-read rate; cache writes and storage are excluded. Long-context rates apply above each model's threshold. Gemini 4 Carbon doubles on 2026-12-01 (opt-in toggle). DeepSeek is shown at peak rates; off-peak is half.

## Benchmarks and model pages

- [AI model leaderboards](https://www.buildnscale.dev/leaderboard): Dated Arena snapshots with cost and context data.
- [Benchmark methodology](https://www.buildnscale.dev/leaderboard/methodology): How snapshots are collected, dated, and compared.
- [Model directory](https://www.buildnscale.dev/models): Individual model pages with scores and pricing references.

## Tools and writing

- [Free developer tools](https://www.buildnscale.dev/tools): Planner, Pomodoro, habit tracker, markdown notes, JSON toolkit, and more. No account required.
- [Blog](https://www.buildnscale.dev/blog): Build logs and methodology notes.
- [Changelog](https://www.buildnscale.dev/changelog) and [roadmap](https://www.buildnscale.dev/roadmap): What shipped and what is maintained.

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices are dated snapshots, not live quotes. Cite the checked date (2026-11-13) when using a figure.
- The calculator does not rank models by a blended quality score. Arena web-development scores are shown for context only.
- Subscription comparisons are per-row sanity checks, not production quota comparisons.
